name: Meerkat
title: Meerkat — Installation Check-in
description: Optional installation tracking. Lets AirTrack support know this install exists and is active — nothing more. Opt-in only, and you can switch it off again at any time.
consent_text:
Meerkat is an optional health monitor for your AirTrack installation. When enabled, it lets AirTrack's support systems know that this installation is healthy and helps identify problems such as failed updates, stopped services, or low disk space. To do that, it registers this installation with Wombat, AirTrack's licensing and delivery service.

What gets sent:
- An installation ID and your licence ID (as before)
- Basic health status: whether AirTrack and its database are running, disk space headroom, and whether scheduled jobs and updates completed successfully
- If a significant problem is detected, that report is sent immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled check-in
- If you choose Send Support Report, the diagnostic bundle is delivered through the same secure channel

What does NOT get sent, ever:
- No aircraft records, flight logs, or any Logbook data
- Meerkat never accepts remote commands. It only reports information about events that have already occurred within your AirTrack installation.
- Meerkat reports what has already happened. It does not monitor how you use AirTrack.

Why it exists: Meerkat helps AirTrack detect installation health problems and lets support understand whether an installation is active and operating normally. It is informational only and does not prevent you from using AirTrack.

You can opt out at any time from this Modules page. Opting out tells Wombat this "Meerkat" installation is no longer active; it does not delete AirTrack or affect your licence.
